fields.Name: PreventSelfApproval
fields.Comments: When true, a decision on an approval task (a task whose type has IsApproval set) is accepted only from one of the task's assignees, recorded as that assignee's own decision, and never from the person who created the task (bc-aidp-next-golive#320). Checked on the server for every path that records a decision: the approval panel, the Tasks inbox and other apps' server code. False, the default, accepts every decision as before.

fields.Name: SelfApprovalExemptRole
fields.Comments: The NAME of the MJ role whose holders may decide an approval task they created themselves while PreventSelfApproval is true. They must still be one of its assignees. Empty exempts nobody. A name that is not a role exempts nobody and is logged.

fields.Name: ApprovalReassignRoles
fields.Comments: Comma-separated NAMES of the MJ roles whose holders may change who an approval task (a task whose type has IsApproval set) is assigned to, or remove its assignee (bc-aidp-next-golive#389). Names match trimmed and case-insensitively; a name that is not a role matches nobody and is logged. Nobody may reassign an approval to themselves, whatever their role. Creating assignments is not checked, so workflow routing is unaffected. Empty, the default, lets nobody reassign or remove an approval's assignee.
